elections.system_family: list proportional representation in three tiers: 39 regional constituencies, 9 Land constituencies and the federal constituency
elections.allocation_method: Hare quota (Wahlzahl) in regional and Land constituencies, then federal D’Hondt over all 183 seats

description.en: A party takes part in the Land and federal stages with at least 4% of national valid votes or a seat in a regional constituency (Grundmandat). In every admitted election the parties holding seats are exactly those above 4%.
description.zh: 政党须获得全国有效票至少 4%，或在某一地区选区获得一席（基础议席），方可参加州级与联邦级分配。在已准入的每次选举中，获得席位的政党恰为超过 4% 者。

elections.rule_basis: election-specific: Nationalrats-Wahlordnung 1992 as applied (the announcements cite §§ 107–108); the institutional registry holds the statute

elections.allocation_method: National lists: D'Hondt over 60 seats; a 3% threshold reproduces the printed seats (the decision prints neither the threshold nor the lists taking part). Single-member constituencies and special constituencies: most votes. 13 members for the Serbian community and one more for minorities under 8% are declared elected from candidates on national lists (Arts. 10 and 26(1)).

description.en: Not printed in the decision; a 3% threshold reproduces the printed seats (the same seven lists pass on voters or on valid ballots). The statute text was not read in this iteration.
description.zh: 决定未印门槛；3% 门槛可复现所列席位（按投票人数或有效票计算，通过的均为同样七份名单）。本轮未阅读法律原文。

elections.system_family: proportional: county lists, 3 seats per county (Chamber of Counties)
elections.allocation_method: D'Hondt over 3 seats in each of 21 counties (Art. 27); no threshold printed and none needed to reproduce the seats.
elections.rule_basis: election-specific: the rules applied in the 1993 decisions (Zakon o izborima zastupnika u Sabor Republike Hrvatske (Narodne novine 22/92, 27/92 i 1/93), Arts. 27, 31 and 50; election called by Narodne novine 1/93); D'Hondt over 3 seats per county reproduces the printed seats; the institutional registry record hr-es-sabor holds the current statutory text of the (now unicameral) Sabor

elections.system_family: mixed: national lists (proportional) and single-member constituencies (plurality), special lists for voters abroad, national-minority constituencies
elections.allocation_method: National lists: D'Hondt over 80 seats among lists with at least 5% of valid ballots (Art. 24). Single-member constituencies: most votes (Art. 23). Special lists abroad: D'Hondt over 12 seats among lists with at least 5% (Art. 24a). Minority constituencies: most votes (one seat each; three seats in constituency 5, Art. 58a).

description.en: A list needs at least 5% of valid ballots to take part in the seat allocation; this reproduces the printed seats (coalition thresholds are not printed and not tested).
description.zh: 名单须获得有效票至少 5% 才能参与席位分配；按此可复现所列席位（联盟门槛未印出，未检验）。
